input.free_text_description: This system is a file management platform that serves Admin, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for audit, file access manager, user manager. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Admin, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a Admin, I want to use audit capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
